name: text-to-cad
description: A library of agent skills for CAD, CAE and CAM
one_liner: Lets an AI assistant design real, exportable 3D parts, robot descriptions, and cut-ready drawings from a plain-language description, instead of you learning CAD software.
buyer: A hardware startup founder or product designer without in-house CAD expertise who needs quick part iterations (brackets, enclosures, jigs) without hiring a mechanical engineer for every tweak.
business_use_cases: A Kickstarter hardware founder iterates enclosure designs by describing changes in English instead of paying a contract CAD designer per revision.
A robotics hobbyist shop generates URDF robot description files for custom builds without manually writing XML.
A small fabrication shop uses the DXF and SendCutSend checks to quote and validate customer-submitted cut files automatically.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'design-to-part' service where customers describe a bracket or enclosure and get a manufacturable STEP file back within a day.
License a hosted version to fabrication shops as an automated quote/file-validation front end for their web store.

steal_this: Offer a $49 'describe it, get a 3D-printable file' service on a niche like custom cable organizers or desk mounts, using this as the generation engine.
